div.div:
Downstream consumer
catalogview-pricing-sync-consumer (PricingSync, ADR-0044) receives both events and refreshes the search document's price.
A campaign never writes to prices — without the product-discounts publisher, CatalogView would keep the pre-campaign price forever.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #5A6C86;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #8494aa; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Four modules, six tables.
Prices — nominal price; publishes PriceChangedEvent via CDC.
Campaigns — promotional campaigns; create/end writes campaigns + product-discounts in one TransactWriteItems (ADR-0026 §6).
GatewayCosts — per-provider cost feeding the installment calculation (ADR-0028).
CustomerDiscounts — customer coupon, minted from PointsRedeemedEvent and burned on PaymentAuthorizedEvent (ADR-0046).
Basket never calls Pricing — neither sync nor async (ADR-0026).
Query.rewardConversion is a NONE (local) resolver: values are baked in at synth time, no backend call (ADR-0046 §8).
